title: i18n(plugin-webhooks): ship the webhook object in all eleven platform languages
body:

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgBxjikPH2bUin9o95gbAxsx)_

domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cai5CRdAs4u9gTipWU

Refs #30512 — package 2 of 11 (`@objectstack/plugin-webhooks`). The card stays open: the last PR of the series flips the bundle check to the platform locale table.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** Webhook 对象（`sys_webhook`）的名称、字段、选项、帮助文字和视图名补上 7 种语言：繁体中文、阿拉伯语、法语、巴西葡萄牙语、俄语、德语、韩语，共 11 种，与平台语言表一致。
- **为什么改：** 平台语言表（#29428 裁决 F）要求每个界面带齐 11 种语言；这是第 3 期按包补齐的第 2 个包（47 条）。
- **风险与回滚：** 只加翻译数据和注册行，不动逻辑、schema、接口；原有 4 种语言一字未改。另在 `check-i18n-stale-fill` 的基线里登记 1 条良性巧合（中文无复数，简繁两种都把复数名写作「Webhook」），附理由。回滚即撤 PR。
- **先看：** `src/translations/index.ts`（按表标签注册，zh-CN 在 zh-Hant 前）、`scripts/i18n-stale-fill-baseline.json`（那 1 条巧合），再抽看 `ar.objects.generated.ts`。
- **两分钟验证：** `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --filter=webhooks` 输出 `in sync (21 bundle(s))`，`node scripts/check-i18n-stale-fill.mjs` 退出 0。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- Seven new locales for `sys_webhook` under the platform locale table's tags (`zh-Hant`, `ar`, `fr`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `de`, `ko`): each a `TAG.objects.generated.ts` with all 47 leaves plus its `TAG.source-hashes.generated.ts`, written by the repo's own `os i18n extract --fill=default --source-hashes` and served through `withSourceFallback` like the existing three. `zh-CN` stays ahead of `zh-Hant` in `index.ts`.
- The extract command in `scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts` lists the seven tags and its merge baseline imports the seven bundles, so `check:i18n` covers them from this PR on.
- `scripts/i18n-stale-fill-baseline.json`: one entry, `sys_webhook.pluralLabel`, classified as a benign coincidence with its reason. `zh-CN` already said 「Webhook」 for the plural (Chinese does not inflect), and the natural `zh-Hant` is the same bytes; the gate's cross-locale rule reads two CJK locales agreeing on a Latin-only value that differs from the source (`Webhooks`) as a stale fill. Re-translating either leaf away from the product term would be worse copy, so the gate's documented path (ratchet in, record why) is taken.
- `bundle-ownership.test.ts`: one message sentence, "the four locale bundles" → "every locale bundle".

## Acceptance notes

- **Quality bar (#17508 / PR #19345):** every leaf written for the reader; placeholders, code spans (`signing_secret`, `headers_secret`), JSON examples (`{"Authorization": "Bearer …"}`), header names (`X-Objectstack-Signature`) and identifiers (`snake_case`, `bulk_*`, `HMAC-SHA256`, `sys_secret`, `@objectstack/spec/automation/webhook`) byte-identical, checked mechanically per leaf against `en`. Arabic is RTL prose with identifiers left in Latin script.
- **Leaves equal to English, on purpose:** the HTTP method options `GET` `POST` `PUT` `PATCH` `DELETE` in every locale; beyond those, the product term and native cognates only — `zh-Hant` `Webhook` (label) and `Webhook ID`; `fr` `Webhook`, `Webhooks`, `Description`, `package`; `pt-BR` `Webhook`, `Webhooks`; `de` `Webhook`, `Webhooks`, `Name`, `Definition`. The extractor records each as a source copy (`ar`/`ru`/`ko` 5 entries = the methods only; `zh-Hant`/`pt-BR` 7; `fr`/`de` 9).
- Option labels of `managed_by` / `triggers` are translated (they were already translated in `zh-CN`); the `help` texts keep the option codes (`admin`, `package`, `platform`, `create/update/delete`) as codes, as `zh-CN` does.
